title: Chief Information Security Officer
description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Germany
description:
Why Join Sales at Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways.

We are seeking a German-fluent and Germany-based Enterprise Account Executive to help us win Enterprise (1,000+ employees) accounts by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won.

In this role, you'll focus on new logo acquisition. Our emphasis is on your ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms.

  • 💰 You have strong track record in Enterprise SaaS sales, having closed many $100k sales, and overachieved $1M+ quotas consistently. You have won competitive rip-and-replace opportunities of core/platform technologies.

  • 🤝 You have strong business acumen. You quickly connect the dots between technical problems and their downstream business impacts. You craft compelling business cases with this context.

  • ⚔️ You're adept at competitive or evangelical selling in new or established markets.

  • 🏔️ You skillfully guide prospects through the evaluation—engaging the right stakeholders at the right time to create consensus for a strategic technology decision.

  • 🤓 You enjoy becoming an expert and tailoring discussions to address each prospect’s unique challenges.

  • ⚡️ Your peers describe you as action-oriented and persistent. You're always on the leaderboard for outbound effort and pipeline created.

  • 🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You write and send crisp follow-up emails, on time. You also take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates. (We use HubSpot, Gong, Chili Piper and Apollo.)

  • ✈️ You are willing to travel at least 25% of the time for customer engagements and events.

Requirements:

  • 🤝 You have 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience and have closed many >$100,000 ACV opportunities

  • 📢 You have experience selling complex platform technologies in a sales-led GTM motion

  • 📈 You are a new business hunter and are confident in your abilities to self-source >50% of your own pipeline

  • 🌍 You have sold to multiple regions within EMEA and have strong written and verbal fluency in both English and German

  • 🇩🇪 You are based in Germany

Bonus Points:

You shouldn't apply if:

  • 🎯 You expect Marketing or BDRs to source all of your pipeline for you. This is a hunting role.

  • 💻 You believe that "tech stuff" is the SE's job. Our AEs all develop product acumen while SEs are a partner in our team selling motion.

  • 📊 You prefer to run established playbooks in well defined environments. This role requires creativity and a growth mindset.

  • 🐺 You're a lone wolf. You prefer to go it alone in your pursuit of new business. We believe in a team-selling sales model.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with a Recruiter to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.

  • Written Exercise - You'll complete a short take home assignment to showcase your outbound muscle.

  • Experience Deep Dive (60 min) - You'll walk the Hiring Manager [Casper Bergmans] through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the professional you are today.

  • Challenge Interview (90 min) - This will be made up of two parts:

    • Discovery and Demo Role Play (60 min)

    • Deal Strategy Discussion (30 min)

Benefits

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

Über Joberg

Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d) – mit Option auf Head of SEO & GEO – OTE 130.000 € – Vollzeit – Remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

Die meisten SEO-Stellen suchen jemanden, der Tickets abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der uns sagt, welche Tickets es überhaupt geben sollte.

Über uns

Wir bauen gerade eine zweite Business Unit auf: GEO-SEO für ausgewählte Nischen, die die großen Agenturen nicht beachten. Gemeint ist Sichtbarkeit dort, wo Menschen heute fragen, also bei Google und in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini. Die Nachfrage haben wir in den ersten Verkaufsgesprächen bereits bestätigt.

Dahinter steht Joberg, eine „kleine“, aber feine Marketing-Agentur. Unser erstes Standbein sind Paket-Mailings, mit denen unsere Kund:innen auf dem Schreibtisch von Entscheider:innen landen. Mit der neuen Unit expandieren wir in den SEO/GEO- und vielleicht in Zukunft in den SEA/GEA-Markt. Was dafür noch fehlt, bist du.

Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen.

Ehrlich gesagt

Es gibt noch keinen Prozess, kein Team und kein Handbuch. Das ist kein Mangel, das ist der Job. Du bist Person Nummer eins in diesem Bereich und trägst 100 % der Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Den Plan schreibst du. Und wenn du findest, dass wir falsch liegen, sag es. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Perspektive

Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du setzt SEO, GEO und Bewertungsmanagement für unsere Kund:innen um, von der Analyse bis zum Ergebnis.

  • Du findest heraus, was ein Unternehmen in KI-Antworten nach vorne bringt, und machst daraus eine wiederholbare Methode (Framework/SOP).

  • Du baust das Fulfillment und die automatisierten Workflows mit KI so auf, dass sie mit jedem neuen Kunden besser werden und nicht langsamer.

  • Du sagst uns, welche Nischen sich deiner Meinung nach lohnen und welche nicht.

Was du kannst

  • Google kennst du in- und auswendig: Google Business Profile, Search Console, lokale Rankings und AI Overviews.

  • Du weißt, wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini Quellen auswählen und Unternehmen empfehlen.

  • Du erstellst Websites und Landingpages automatisiert und optimierst sie für SEO und GEO, inklusive strukturierter Daten.

  • Du beherrschst Bewertungsmanagement: mehr echte Bewertungen gewinnen und professionell darauf antworten.

  • Du baust Workflows mit KI und Automationstools, etwa über APIs, n8n oder Make.

  • Du misst Ergebnisse und erklärst sie so, dass Kund:innen sie verstehen.

Woran wir merken, dass du es bist

  • Du lebst KI. Du nutzt sie jeden Tag, beruflich wie privat, und probierst neue Modelle aus, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • Du bist neugierig und ruhst dich nie auf dem Status quo aus. Was gestern funktioniert hat, stellst du heute infrage.

  • Wir müssen dir nichts erklären. Du erklärst uns Dinge, die wir noch nicht wussten.

  • Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert und brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben gibt.

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung, mit einem deutlichen Anteil Local SEO. Je mehr, desto besser.

  • Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bist einfach eine coole, sympathische Person :)

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Eine echte Founding Role mit der Option, Head of SEO & GEO zu werden

  • Ein Gesamteinkommen (OTE) weit über dem Markt, denn wir sind margenstark und teilen den Erfolg

  • Workations: Arbeite auch mal ein paar Wochen von dort, wo andere Urlaub machen.

  • Arbeiten, wo du willst: remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

  • Flache Hierarchien: keine Freigabeschleifen, eine Entscheidung dauert bei uns ein Telefonat.

  • Budget für die KI-Tools, die du brauchst

  • Start ab Januar 2027 oder wann es für dich passt

Gehalt: Fixum 56.200 € brutto im Jahr. On-Target-Earnings (OTE): 130.000 € im Jahr. Wie sich die OTE zusammensetzen, erklären wir dir im ersten Gespräch.

So bewirbst du dich

Nutze den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite mit dem Betreff „Bewerbung Senior SEO & GEO Manager – Vollzeit“:

  1. Deinen Lebenslauf

  2. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, maximal eine Seite: Warum reizt dich genau diese Rolle, und was würdest du in den ersten 90 Tagen anders machen als die meisten? Und wie nutzt du KI heute schon im Alltag?

Pluspunkte, wenn du magst: Ein Vorstellungsvideo von 1 bis 3 Minuten (die Handykamera reicht, schick einfach den Link). Jeder Extra-Aufwand fließt positiv in die Bewertung ein, ist aber kein Muss.

Du hörst innerhalb von 5 Werktagen von uns, auch wenn es ein Nein ist.

Du kennst jemanden, der perfekt passt? Schick uns den Kontakt. Führt deine Empfehlung zur Einstellung, bedanken wir uns mit 3.000 €, sobald die Person die Probezeit bestanden hat.

title: Principal Field Engineer, US Remote
description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Our Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers are aligned to accounts, segments and Account Executives. This role isn't. As a Principal Field Engineer, you work across the whole business: every region, every segment, presales and post-sales. Your job is to make Exa impossible to ignore for developers and technical buyers, and to make every Field Engineer better at showing what Exa can do.

You'll build the demos, workshops and on-demand training the team and our customers use everywhere, take Exa on the road to conferences, meetups and user groups, and become the go-to expert the team pulls in when a deal or a customer needs someone who knows Exa inside out. You'll spend a lot of time where developers are, and a lot of time on a plane. This is not a slideware role. You are an engineer who builds, teaches and shows.

In this role, you will:

  • Build the demos the whole team uses: flagship demos, sample apps, cookbooks and reference architectures that show Exa on real problems, and keep them current as the product ships

  • Design and deliver workshops, hands-on labs and technical webinars for prospects, customers and developer communities, and package them so any Field Engineer can run them

  • Create on-demand training content: video tutorials, self-paced courses and recorded labs that teach customers, developers and new Field Engineers how to build with Exa, without anyone in the room

  • Represent Exa at events: conference talks, booth demos, hackathons and partner events, in person, wherever the audience is

  • Start and run meetups and user groups in key cities, and grow a community of developers building with Exa

  • Be the team's subject-matter expert on Exa's products, search quality, evals and agent use cases; join key deals and customer escalations when SAs and FDEs need deeper help

  • Turn new launches into field-ready material: demos, talk tracks and competitive positioning, so the team can sell what Product ships on day one

  • Partner with Marketing on technical content, blog posts and events that generate pipeline

  • Bring what you hear back to Product: what developers try to build, where they get stuck, and what competitors are doing

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build polished demos and sample apps from scratch, fast, and you enjoy it

  • 4+ years in a technical customer-facing role (solutions architect, sales engineer, developer advocate or similar), ideally at an AI-native, API or developer-first company

  • A track record of teaching and presenting to technical audiences: talks, workshops, webinars, video tutorials or community events

  • Strong communication skills: you can hold a room of engineers, then explain the same thing simply to an executive

  • Self-directed: you can set your own priorities without a segment or a quota to tell you where to go

  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including internationally

You might excel if you...

  • Have spoken at developer conferences, run a meetup, or built a community around a technical product

  • Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

  • Have a following or a body of public work: open-source projects, technical blog posts, talks, videos

  • Love the moment a room full of developers sees a demo and gets it

  • Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is a remote role based in the US, with travel to events, customers and our San Francisco HQ. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

As Head of Warehouse Projects, you will own the delivery execution of major CapEx implementation projects — from retrofits and G2P integrations in legacy sites to full layout rollouts for new expansion sites across Europe.

You are the single point of accountability for bringing approved designs to life. Taking an signed-off operational layout, you will drive the entire program through site readiness, vendor management, budget control, and commissioning — delivering fully operational sites on time, on budget, and ready for local teams.

Why this role is exciting

  • Single point of ownership: You own the delivery execution end-to-end — holding ultimate accountability for whether complex, multi-million euro automation projects land on time and perform as expected.

  • Cutting-edge automation: Direct hands-on delivery of large-scale CapEx projects involving advanced goods-to-person (G2P/AS-RS) systems, conveyors, racking, and automated material handling.

  • European expansion scope: Play a central role in scaling Rohlik’s operational footprint across multiple European countries.

  • High organizational visibility: Interface directly with leadership across Automation, Engineering, Procurement, Facilities, and Operations.

  • High-impact execution: Transform theoretical engineering designs into fully functioning, high-throughput fulfillment hubs.

What you will own and deliver

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the execution of warehouse implementation projects (fit-outs, retrofits, and new site layouts) from project kickoff through commissioning, go-live, and operational handover.

  • Program & Schedule Management: Drive project plans, schedules, budgets, resourcing, and critical-path milestones, taking accountability for keeping all deliverables on track.

  • Vendor & Site Governance: Manage external contractors, equipment vendors, and integrators on-site, ensuring quality standards and delivery commitments are met.

  • Risk Management & Escalation: Identify project dependencies and risks early, maintaining structured RACI matrices and resolving blockers proactively.

  • Engineering degree (Industrial, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or a related technical field).

  • Technical literacy in automation: Solid practical understanding of material handling systems, conveyors, racking, and goods-to-person (G2P / AS-RS) technologies to effectively manage vendors and engineering partners.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Financial Crime Intelligence & Investigations Team as a Financial Crime SAR Manager? Reporting to the Senior Manager, you’ll act as a subject matter expert for financial crime intelligence analysis across our client base. Including conducting analysis of potential suspicious activity across a range of financial crime escalations, producing reports for both internal and external audiences, and providing support across the wider team where needed.

Candidates need to have proven experience in financial crime intelligence across different payment platforms and services. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies, detection methods and intelligence analysis techniques, and share this knowledge with other members of the team. You’ll be comfortable working in an energetic environment and dealing with change whilst taking pride in owning and mitigating financial crime risk for the business.

You’ll demonstrate the confidence to raise concerns, shape strategic thinking and make well-informed decisions. You’ll bring strong knowledge of payment services, together with extensive technical and regulatory expertise across financial crime and sanctions in the UK and other jurisdictions, including relevant reporting obligations. You’ll also have a proven ability to identify, assess, and mitigate financial crime risk across the business.

Your role includes:

  • Leading complex financial crime investigations and providing senior-level oversight, challenge and direction on material or high-risk cases

  • Overseeing the allocation and prioritisation of investigative activity, ensuring resources are effectively deployed and key regulatory and operational deadlines are met

  • Building and managing effective relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, providing clear advice, challenge and escalation on financial crime matters

  • Providing oversight of financial crime risks associated with existing and emerging products and services, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are developed and implemented

  • Driving the development of financial crime, sanctions and money laundering typology knowledge across the team and wider business

  • Overseeing complex end-to-end enquiries and ensuring appropriate, timely and risk-based outcomes

  • Directing and overseeing research and intelligence activity to support the identification, assessment and investigation of potentially suspicious activity

  • Providing oversight and approval of relevant regulatory reports and disclosures, ensuring compliance with applicable AML legislation, regulation and reporting obligations

  • Accountable for team outcomes and responsible for complex/high risk decision making

  • Applying extensive technical and regulatory expertise to identify control weaknesses, assess risk exposure and influence appropriate remediation

  • Acting as a senior subject matter expert on financial crime and maintaining awareness of emerging AML trends, typologies and industry developments to strengthen the Bank’s detection and control capabilities

  • Developing strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to influence decision-making, support strategic objectives and deliver effective financial crime risk management

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading and providing oversight of complex financial crime investigations

  • Strong knowledge and practical application of financial crime control frameworks, regulatory requirements and industry standards

  • Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial

  • Understanding of UK and EU AML/CTF legislation (international AML/CTF knowledge is advantageous)

  • Meticulous organisational skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders

  • Understanding of money laundering typologies across a range of products and services

  • Solutions driven, with the appetite for constant improvement

  • In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information

  • A recognised AML/Sanctions/Fraud qualification is highly desirable

  • Previous experience of Delegated Nominated Officer responsibilities would be advantageous

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one - who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

What You'll Do

As Head of Engineering, you will lead Radiant's engineering organisation and be accountable for its execution, technical quality, reliability, and scalability.

You'll lead software engineering, platform security engineering, and architecture: an organisation of 30-35 engineers today, growing to 150 to 200+ as Radiant expands internationally. You'll partner closely with Product, the Customer team, Infrastructure, SRE, Operations, the PMO, and the wider technology leadership team.

This is a senior leadership role focused on building a high-performing engineering organisation capable of delivering and operating complex AI infrastructure at scale. You'll stay close to the work through design review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hire and scale the engineering organisation, building a strong leadership layer across Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical leaders.

  • Own engineering hiring, performance, leadership development, succession planning, and organisational health.

  • Design and evolve the engineering organisation as the company scales across teams, sites, and regions.

  • Own the engineering strategy, operating model, and execution in alignment with company and product objectives.

  • Translate business priorities into clear technical plans, sequencing, investment decisions, and delivery commitments.

  • Establish clear ownership, decision-making, and accountability across engineering teams.

  • Drive predictable, high-quality delivery, identifying risk early and intervening where execution drifts.

  • Ensure systems are designed and delivered to be production-ready, reliable, observable, maintainable, and supportable.

  • Strengthen collaboration with infrastructure, SRE, and operations, including effective handover and incident learning.

  • Set and uphold standards across architecture, engineering quality, security, scalability, and operational maturity.

  • Own the roadmap jointly with Product: Product owns what is built, and you own how and when.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for critical technical, architectural, and delivery decisions, brokering decisions between peers and escalating to the CTO when needed.

  • Improve engineering maturity and processes while avoiding unnecessary bureaucracy or loss of delivery momentum.

  • Represent engineering in executive and partner discussions, and join customer escalation reviews with the Customer team.

Your Profile

  • Significant experience leading and scaling engineering organisations of 20+ engineers through multiple stages of growth.

  • Experience managing managers, with a strong track record of hiring and developing Engineering Managers, senior engineers, and technical leaders.

  • Proven experience evolving a smaller engineering group into multiple teams with clear ownership, leadership, and consistent delivery.

  • Experience designing organisational structures, team boundaries, and operating models for increasing scale and complexity.

  • Demonstrated success improving delivery predictability, engineering quality, throughput, and organisational effectiveness.

  • Strong technical background across modern software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure-heavy products.

  • Experience owning production systems where reliability, observability, scalability, and operational readiness are critical.

  • Comfortable working closely with Product, Infrastructure, SRE, Operations, and Commercial teams.

  • Experience operating across multiple teams, locations, or time zones.

  • Able to communicate technical risk, trade-offs, and opportunity clearly at executive level.

  • Experience with cloud or infrastructure platforms, scaled SaaS, AI/ML platforms, or infrastructure-heavy technology businesses is strongly preferred.

How You Work

  • You move fast and correct course quickly.

  • You challenge openly, then commit.

  • You address underperformance within weeks, with clear coaching and firm deadlines.

  • You keep process light and standards high.

What You Bring

  • Engineering leadership: You build strong teams, strong leaders, and clear accountability.

  • Execution: You create predictability and drive complex programmes through to completion.

  • Technical judgement: You can guide architecture and challenge senior engineers without becoming a bottleneck.

  • Systems thinking: You understand organisations, platforms, and operating models as interconnected systems.

  • Operational mindset: You expect engineering output to be reliable, supportable, and production-ready.

  • Organisational design: You know when structures, processes, or ownership models need to evolve.

  • Calm leadership: You remain decisive under pressure and make clear trade-offs when required.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for engineering outcomes, organisational health, and long-term capability.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: a conversation with our Talent team, then interviews with our CTO and leadership team.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
Senior Content Manager

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

We're reshaping how we plan and create content at Phrase. A new Content Working Group brings together demand generation, SEO and AI search, paid media, marketing ops, localization and creative under one strategic umbrella. The ambition is clear: every piece of content earns its place, engages in its own right and reflects the quality of the platform we build.

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager to sit at the centre of this. Someone who thinks editorially, obsesses over audience and brings the creative confidence to raise the bar across everything we publish. You'll own content strategy and planning, develop and maintain our content calendar, brief and manage writers, coordinate our design studio, and work alongside specialists in paid, organic, demand gen and localization who are collectively invested in the work. You'll also be working with the people building our product (genuine thought leaders in AI and language technology) and with external experts in the field, turning deep knowledge into stories that resonate.

This is a chance to shape a content function at a company that takes content seriously, in an industry going through one of its most fascinating periods of change.

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Own the content strategy across the full marketing funnel, working within the Content Working Group to shape quarterly plans, balance priorities and ensure every asset has a clear audience, purpose and measurable goal.

  • Develop and maintain the content calendar to keep a consistent, strategically aligned publishing rhythm across channels and funnel stages.

  • Write, commission and edit content across formats: blog posts, reports, video scripts, campaign narratives, case studies, ebooks, email sequences. You'll write well, and edit even better. For high-value pieces (original research, designed reports, narrative campaigns), you'll commission and manage specialist contributors and agencies to deliver work that genuinely stands out.

  • Apply our editorial approach. We want content that people genuinely want to read, watch and share. Content built on original insight, sharp storytelling and distinctive points of view. You'll champion this standard across the team and help inspire others to aim higher.

  • Compile and present content strategy and plans with confidence and conviction, whether to the Content Working Group, senior leadership or cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Coordinate the design studio. Two designers support content production, campaigns, reports and communications. You'll plan and prioritise their workload, keeping jobs moving and ensuring the right work gets the right attention at the right time. Think studio manager: organised, clear, good at keeping plates spinning.

  • Harness AI with intention. Phrase has developed a three-tier content model (Gold, Silver, Bronze) that determines how much human creative investment each piece needs. You'll apply this framework, using AI tools where they accelerate production and protecting the space for original, human-led thinking where it matters most.

  • Fly the flag for content. You'll be the person who pushes for great work, brings energy to the process and motivates the people around you to produce their best. Content touches every part of marketing at Phrase, and we need someone who promotes its value, celebrates what's working and holds the standard when it counts.

  • Track what's working. With support from Marketing Operations, use data and analytics to inform what we create next and to demonstrate content's influence on pipeline and business outcomes.

  • Manage the content budget, allocating resources across writing, design and production.

What you need:

  • 6-10 years in content marketing, editorial or content strategy, with meaningful experience in B2B technology or SaaS.

  • A strong portfolio that shows range: editorial flair, strategic thinking and the ability to shift between a thought leadership piece, a technically grounded blog post and a campaign narrative.

  • Sharp editorial judgement. You know when something is good enough and when it could be better, and you have the skill and the tact to close that gap.

  • Experience managing writers, freelancers or agencies, with a track record of getting strong work out of the people you brief.

  • Confidence with AI content tools. Phrase is an AI company and we expect fluency, not just familiarity.

  • A working knowledge of SEO and genuine curiosity about how AI search is reshaping content discoverability. Comfortable with analytics platforms (e.g. Google Analytics, Semrush) and able to draw insight from performance data.

  • Excellent project management instincts. You can juggle multiple workstreams, keep deadlines honest and stay calm when priorities shift.

  • The ability to coordinate creative resources, keep projects on track and manage competing priorities without losing your composure.

  • Energy! You bring momentum to the teams you work with. You push for great work because you care about it, and that's infectious.

Helpful extras:

  • Experience in localization, language technology or translation. (This isn't essential, but it gives you a head start.)

  • A background in journalism, editorial or publishing.

  • Familiarity with video content production, from scripting to briefing agencies.

  • Experience with HubSpot, WordPress or similar platforms.

Why this role is worth your attention

You'll be part of a Content Working Group that genuinely debates, challenges and collaborates. Your ideas will shape the plan and your standards will set the tone.

Phrase is an AI company building technology that helps the world's biggest brands communicate across languages and cultures. We have an AI Research team in-house, and everyone here is being equipped to work with AI in meaningful ways. You'll have access to tools, training and a culture that treats AI as something to get excited about.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing Strategy, Creative and Brand, with the autonomy to shape the content function and the backing to make ambitious ideas happen.

What you’ll get:

  • Work experience in a successful and growing global SaaS company

  • Be part of an international team in Europe, APAC, and the Americas

  • Expert colleagues in their field who are determined to build the best localization platform on the market, creating a world where language never limits opportunity

  • An agile work environment, where it is encouraged to take smart risks

  • Take part in a culture full of trust, support and loyalty, where respectful and open feedback is valued, and diversity is fully embraced

  • A positive, open-minded, and innovative atmosphere

  • Support in your professional development and personal career goals

What's on top:

  • 4 Company holidays additional to your regular holidays (1 day per quarter where the entire company is off to celebrate our achievements).

  • In addition, the company also provides employees with a Christmas break to allow you to spend time with family and friends without use of your vacation allocation.

  • Your birthday is off because it is important to celebrate you as well.

  • 2 Giveback days where you can support the local community, volunteer, and/or participate in charity events and activities.

  • Professional and extensive onboarding.

  • Learning & development through Phrase learning and a dedicated Claude Enterprise user license

  • Additional local benefits depending on the entity you're hired at, just ask your Talent Acquisition Partner

Phrase is committed to ensuring equal pay for equal work and work of equal value between women and men. Our aim is that our workforce will be truly representative of all sections of society and that each worker feels respected and able to give their best. The job requirements and salary range for this job have been established through a gender-neutral job evaluation and classification process. This process objectively assesses the skills, responsibility, effort and working conditions required for each job. This systematic approach ensures fair pay regardless of who performs the work. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their sex, race or ethnicity, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, gender identity or age.

We value and welcome different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds as we believe that these differences make our team even stronger on our mission of opening the door to global business by giving everybody access to the content they need in the language they speak

title: Product Manager, Agent Platform
description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena runs customer experience for consumer brands through a connected multi-agent stack. As Product Manager, Core Agent Platform, you'll own the platform those agents run on, from its current capabilities to where it goes next. You'll own how we measure, test and improve agent performance, and how customers see it. You'll work directly with engineering, deployment and customers, and you'll be expected to build as well as specify.

What You'll Do

  • Own the core agent platform end to end, including the roadmap and the day-to-day product decisions.

  • Build and ship the evaluation, testing and monitoring systems that make agent performance measurably better over time.

  • Design and run structured experiments and A/B tests across agent workflows.

  • Give customers clear visibility into how their agents are performing.

  • Prototype your own ideas with coding agents, and ship them where you can, rather than waiting on a hand-off.

  • Work with customers and our deployment team to understand what's working in the field and turn it into product.

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

  • 3+ years as a PM in CX, ecommerce, helpdesk or AI automation.

  • Technical fluency: you can explain how webhooks, OAuth and integrations work and have made product decisions around them.

  • AI-native builder: you use tools like Claude, Cursor or v0 daily and have prototyped your own product ideas with them.

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

  • You've run structured experiments or A/B tests and can say what the data did and didn't tell you.

  • You've built dashboards or visibility features people actually relied on.

  • You're confident with customers: you've sat in on calls, run demos, and know what end users really complain about.

  • You act like the CEO of your product area: strong opinions, and a habit of building and talking to customers without being asked.

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

  • Engineering background, or you've shipped production code yourself.

Not a Fit If:

  • You wait to be told what to build.

  • You want a narrowly scoped PM seat with a fixed roadmap handed to you.

  • You're not comfortable being customer-facing or getting on a call to demo your own work.

  • You'd rather stay behind the product than own the messy, ambiguous parts.

  • You need a designer or engineer to turn your product vision into something people can click.

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How we hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: GTM Associate
description:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

As a GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue.

You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE.

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win.

If you’re at the start of your commercial career, energised by meeting new people, and keen to take on more responsibility fast, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own early-stage pipeline creation with fintechs and financial institutions that match our ideal customer profile

  • Research and map target accounts, identifying the right C-level Risk & Compliance, Operations, and Product leaders to engage

  • Help build and run our outbound motion, with sharp, well-researched messaging across email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Test creative formats beyond the usual sequences, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook

  • Respond fast to inbound interest and qualify every lead on fit, urgency and decision-makers

  • Lead discovery calls, support AEs on live deals and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end

  • Bring what you hear from the market back to Product and Leadership, helping shape who we sell to and spot new market opportunities

  • Pick up whatever the business needs next: priorities will shift as we scale, and you’ll help shape where we go

What you bring:

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

The Senior Product Analyst, Merchant will be the dedicated analytics lead for Zilch’s Merchant domain - the space where shopping discovery, merchant-funded advertising, paid display, paid search, affiliate conversion, and customer engagement come together.

Reporting into Product Analytics and partnering closely with the Senior Product Manager for Merchant, you’ll help build the analytical foundation for Zilch’s intelligent commerce platform. This is a two-sided problem: we need to improve the customer shopping experience while helping merchants drive measurable ROAS through Zilch’s closed-loop payments and behavioural data.

Here, paid display and paid search refer to advertising inventory we sell to merchants, not media we buy. You’ll help define how this inventory is measured, targeted, optimised, and monetised across the Zilch app.

You’ll analyse the full shopping journey - from browsing and search, through merchant discovery, unlocks, clickouts, transactions, and repeat engagement - to understand where users drop off, what drives intent, and which product features can improve engagement, conversion, and monetisation.

This is not a reporting-only role. The analysis, experimentation, and models you build will directly shape what customers see, how merchants are surfaced, and how we move from static merchandising towards data-driven discovery, allocation, and personalisation.

Day to day responsibilities.

  • Own analytics for Zilch’s Merchant domain, covering shopping discovery, customer browsing behaviour, merchant-funded paid display and paid search, affiliate conversion, merchant ROAS, and marketplace performance.

  • Analyse the customer shopping journey across browsing, search, merchant discovery, unlocks, clickouts, transactions, and repeat usage to identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, and monetisation.

  • Design and analyse experiments across merchant placements and shopping features, including targeted vs random allocation, paid display exposure, search ranking, storefront changes, offer discovery, and journey improvements.

  • Build the measurement framework for merchant-funded growth, including incrementality, attribution windows, exposed vs control logic, ROAS, CPA, conversion, revenue per impression, and margin impact.

  • Partner with Product and Commercial to shape audience packages and targeting strategies, ensuring they are commercially sellable, analytically measurable, and grounded in customer behaviour.

  • Develop segmentation approaches for merchant-funded display and search, including category affinity, value bands, browsing intent, cross-sell audiences, lapsed users, and future lookalike opportunities.

  • Support the evolution from simple segment-based targeting towards more advanced allocation logic, recommendation systems, and marketplace decisioning.

  • Work with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Engineering on the data foundations for merchant personalisation, including event tracking, feature creation, experimentation infrastructure, and model evaluation.

  • Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for Product, Commercial, and senior leadership.


What we're looking for...

  • Ideally, 5+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, marketplace analytics, retail media analytics, performance marketing analytics, data science, or a closely adjacent role.

  • Strong commercial judgement and fluency in ROAS, CPA, incrementality, attribution, LTV, conversion, margin, and marketplace trade-offs.

  • Deep data skills. You’re fluent in SQL, comfortable working with large behavioural datasets, and able to independently investigate ambiguous problems, define the right metrics, and produce robust analysis.

  • Rigorous experimentation experience. You can design clean A/B tests, reason about incrementality and power, interpret results honestly, and know when data is good enough to act on.

  • Experience analysing digital funnels, browsing behaviour, search behaviour, clickouts, conversion, paid placements, shopping discovery, or marketplace dynamics.

title: Principal Consultant - Strategic Infrastructure Advisory
description:
About Infrata

Infrata, part of dss+, is a specialist infrastructure advisory business of around 100 people working with investors, lenders, owners, operators and governments across transport, aviation, maritime, energy, digital infrastructure and the energy transition.

Our reputation is built on technical and commercial due diligence: fast, rigorous, independent work on the assets and businesses our clients are buying, financing or operating. We are now building on that base to offer clients strategic advice across the full life of an asset, not only at the point of transaction.

Why this role

Infrata has strong technical expertise and established client relationships. We are looking for someone who can help us build on these strengths by developing new consulting services, winning work and leading projects.

You will work with our technical specialists to identify where clients need advice beyond due diligence, develop services we are well placed to deliver, and take them to clients. You will also lead the projects you win, bringing in specialists as needed.

Your impact at Infrata

The role has three main responsibilities: developing services, winning work and leading delivery.

  • Develop services. Work with clients and colleagues to identify problems we have the expertise to address but do not currently advise on. Develop services we can deliver consistently, with a clear scope, team, price and evidence of their value.

  • Win work. Introduce these services to existing and new clients, lead proposals and presentations, and secure new projects.

  • Lead delivery. Lead the projects you win, agreeing the approach, managing the client relationship and team, and taking responsibility for the quality of the advice. Our due diligence specialists will contribute their expertise; you will be responsible for the overall engagement.

Key accountabilities

Service development

  • Understand the team's expertise and identify opportunities to offer advisory services beyond due diligence.

  • Test ideas with clients before investing in their development, and focus on those with genuine demand.

  • Define the client need, approach, team, fees and deliverables for each service, supported by evidence of our experience.

  • Build the supporting material: credentials, case studies, proposal templates, pitch decks.

  • Identify opportunities to sell Infrata's data and analytical tools as products or recurring services, and assess whether they are commercially viable. You will establish what clients would pay for and work with our data and technology colleagues to develop it; you are not expected to build the technology yourself.

Business development

  • Carry a personal sales target for new strategic advisory work (target to be agreed at offer).

  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at investors, lenders, operators and public bodies.

  • Identify opportunities, qualify them, and write or lead proposals and pitches.

  • Work with sector leads to extend existing due diligence relationships into advisory work.

  • Keep the pipeline and client records in our systems current.

Engagement leadership

  • Act as lead consultant on engagements you win: scope, plan, staff, budget, and deliver.

  • Define the questions the project needs to answer and the analysis required. Take responsibility for the conclusions and final recommendations.

  • Manage the client relationship day to day, including scope changes, difficult messages and sign-off.

  • Run the project team, including specialists drawn from across Infrata and dss+, and give them clear briefs and feedback.

  • Deliver high-quality work on time and within budget, building client confidence and opportunities for further work.

Building the team's consulting capability

  • Coach due diligence staff who work on your engagements in consulting skills: problem structuring, client handling, writing for decision-makers, presenting.

  • Set clear standards for strategic advisory proposals, workplans and deliverables, and apply them in your own work.

  • Help improve resourcing, time recording, project management and cash collection across Infrata.

Service areas in scope

The role covers four service areas. You should have the experience to lead projects in at least one of these areas and be comfortable selling services across all four.

Strategy
You will advise owners, operators, developers and public bodies on areas including market entry and growth strategy, asset and portfolio strategy, business planning, governance and assurance, policy and regulatory positioning, and investment case development.

Value creation
Working primarily with private equity and infrastructure fund investors and their portfolio companies, you will lead engagements such as full-potential reviews, 100-day plans, operational and commercial improvement programmes, exit readiness and portfolio performance reviews.

Climate advisory
You will support investors, lenders and operators with decarbonisation roadmaps, climate risk and resilience assessments, transition planning, sustainability strategy, and ESG and climate reporting.

Data and digital services
You will help investors, lenders, operators and public bodies get greater value from data. This could include turning existing traffic, asset, transaction and benchmark data into advisory products or subscription services, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery, and helping clients make better use of their own data.

Most projects will combine Infrata's knowledge of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy and digital infrastructure with dss+ expertise in operations, safety and sustainability.


Who you are

Essential experience

  • At least eight years in management consulting, strategy consulting or advisory, including substantial experience in infrastructure. A background in project finance, lender's or investor's technical advisory, or assurance would help you understand our clients' needs and how our team works.

  • Experience leading strategy, value creation or climate advisory projects, with responsibility for the engagement rather than an individual part of the work.

  • Direct experience of winning work: writing proposals, pitching, negotiating scope and fees, and converting relationships into revenue.

  • Experience developing or launching a new service, product or practice area, including on a small scale.

  • Experience leading mixed teams of generalists and technical specialists.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience of project finance, due diligence or technical assurance on infrastructure transactions, and of the lenders, investors and sponsors involved.

  • Experience working with private equity or infrastructure fund investors on portfolio companies.

  • Sector depth in one of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy or digital infrastructure.

  • Climate, decarbonisation or sustainability advisory experience.

  • Experience commercialising data, analytics or digital products within a professional services business.

  • A second European language, or experience working with teams in Spain, Latin America or Canada.

Capabilities

  • Can make sense of complex or poorly defined problems and explain them clearly.

  • Writes and presents for senior decision-makers.

  • Exercises sound commercial judgement on project costs, fees and which opportunities to pursue.

  • Comfortable with technical detail without needing to be the technical expert.

  • Uses AI and data tools confidently and understands when they are useful for clients and when they are not. Technical development skills are not required.

  • Works well with technical specialists, including those new to consulting, earning their trust and helping them contribute effectively.

  • Takes initiative and is comfortable developing new services and ways of working, particularly in the first year.

Education and languages

  • Degree in engineering, economics, finance, business, environmental science or a related discipline. MBA or equivalent is useful but not required.

  • Fluent English.

Mobility

  • Willing to travel to clients and to Infrata and dss+ offices as the work requires.

What you'll experience at dss+

  • The opportunity to help build our strategic advisory practice.
